declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy
declarations.source_header: def runsOpsBy (lt : α → α → Bool) : List α → Measured (List (List α)) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.ascOpsBy
declarations.source_header:
def ascOpsBy (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (f : Builder α) :
      List α → Measured (List (List α)) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.descOpsBy
declarations.source_header:
def descOpsBy (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (acc : List α) :
      List α → Measured (List (List α)) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_nil
declarations.source_header: @[simp] theorem runsOpsBy_nil (lt : α → α → Bool) : runsOpsBy lt [] = ([], 1)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_singleton
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem runsOpsBy_singleton (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) :
    runsOpsBy lt [a] = ([[a]], 3)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_cons_cons
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_cons_cons (lt : α → α → Bool) (a b : α) (xs : List α) :
    runsOpsBy lt (a :: b :: xs) =
      if lt b a then
        ((descOpsBy lt b [a] xs).1, 3 + (descOpsBy lt b [a] xs).2)
      else
        ((ascOpsBy lt b (singleton a) xs).1,
          3 + (ascOpsBy lt b (singleton a) xs).2)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.ascOpsBy_nil
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem ascOpsBy_nil (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (f : Builder α) :
    ascOpsBy lt a f [] = ([(f [a]).1], (f [a]).2 + 3)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.ascOpsBy_cons
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascOpsBy_cons (lt : α → α → Bool) (a b : α) (f : Builder α) (bs : List α) :
    ascOpsBy lt a f (b :: bs) =
      if lt b a then
        ((f [a]).1 :: (runsOpsBy lt (b :: bs)).1,
          (f [a]).2 + 4 + (runsOpsBy lt (b :: bs)).2)
      else
        ((ascOpsBy lt b (pushRun a f).1 bs).1,
          4 + (ascOpsBy lt b (pushRun a f).1 bs).2)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.descOpsBy_nil
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem descOpsBy_nil (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (acc : List α) :
    descOpsBy lt a acc [] = ([a :: acc], 3)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.descOpsBy_cons
declarations.source_header:
theorem descOpsBy_cons (lt : α → α → Bool) (a b : α) (acc bs : List α) :
    descOpsBy lt a acc (b :: bs) =
      if lt b a then
        ((descOpsBy lt b (a :: acc) bs).1, 3 + (descOpsBy lt b (a :: acc) bs).2)
      else
        ((a :: acc) :: (runsOpsBy lt (b :: bs)).1,
          4 + (runsOpsBy lt (b :: bs)).2)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleton_toDList
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleton_toDList (a : α) :
    toDList (singleton a) [a] (singleton_rep a) = Batteries.DList.singleton a

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_value (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α) :
      (runsOpsBy lt xs).1 = runsBy lt xs

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.ascOpsBy_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascOpsBy_value (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (f : Builder α)
      (pref : List α) (rep : Rep f pref) (ys : List α) :
      (ascOpsBy lt a f ys).1 = ascBy lt a (toDList f pref rep) ys

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.descOpsBy_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem descOpsBy_value (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (acc ys : List α) :
      (descOpsBy lt a acc ys).1 = descBy lt a acc ys

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_perm
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_perm (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α) :
    (runsOpsBy lt xs).1.flatten.Perm xs

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_flatten_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_flatten_length (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α) :
    (runsOpsBy lt xs).1.flatten.length = xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_length_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_length_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α) :
    (runsOpsBy lt xs).1.length ≤ xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_sorted
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_sorted [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α) :
    ∀ run ∈ (runsOpsBy (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs).1, KeySorted key run

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_work_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_work_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α) :
      (runsOpsBy lt xs).2 ≤ 6 * xs.length + 1

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.ascOpsBy_work_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascOpsBy_work_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (f : Builder α)
      (ys : List α) (k : Nat) (cost : AppCost f k) :
      (ascOpsBy lt a f ys).2 ≤ k + 6 * ys.length + 5

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.descOpsBy_work_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem descOpsBy_work_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (acc ys : List α) :
      (descOpsBy lt a acc ys).2 ≤ 6 * ys.length + 5

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.ascOpsBy_buildFrom
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascOpsBy_buildFrom (lt : α → α → Bool) (a last : α) (f : Builder α)
    (middle : List α)
    (chain : (a :: (middle ++ [last])).IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) :
    ascOpsBy lt a f (middle ++ [last]) =
      ([((buildFrom (a :: middle) f).1 [last]).1],
        (buildFrom (a :: middle) f).2 + ((buildFrom (a :: middle) f).1 [last]).2 +
          2 * (middle.length + 1) + 3)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending
declarations.source_header: def buildAscending (first : α) (middle : List α) : Measured (Builder α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_eq
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_eq (first : α) (middle : List α) :
    buildAscending first middle =
      ((buildFrom middle (singleton first)).1,
        1 + (buildFrom middle (singleton first)).2)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_cost (first : α) (middle : List α) :
    (buildAscending first middle).2 = 1 + 2 * middle.length

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_rep
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_rep (first : α) (middle : List α) :
    Rep (buildAscending first middle).1 (first :: middle)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_appCost
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_appCost (first : α) (middle : List α) :
    AppCost (buildAscending first middle).1 (1 + 2 * middle.length)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_apply
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_apply (first : α) (middle suffix : List α) :
    (buildAscending first middle).1 suffix =
      ((first :: middle) ++ suffix, 1 + 2 * middle.length)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_weight
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_weight (first : α) (middle suffix : List α) :
    (buildAscending first middle).2 + 1 = 2 * (first :: middle).length ∧
      ((buildAscending first middle).1 suffix).2 + 1 = 2 * (first :: middle).length

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_counts_add_three
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_counts_add_three (first : α) (middle : List α) (last : α) :
    (buildAscending first middle).2 + 3 = 2 * (first :: (middle ++ [last])).length ∧
      ((buildAscending first middle).1 [last]).2 + 3 =
        2 * (first :: (middle ++ [last])).length

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.buildAscending_counts
declarations.source_header:
theorem buildAscending_counts (first : α) (middle : List α) (last : α) :
    (buildAscending first middle).2 = 2 * (first :: (middle ++ [last])).length - 3 ∧
      ((buildAscending first middle).1 [last]).2 =
        2 * (first :: (middle ++ [last])).length - 3

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_buildAscending
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_buildAscending (lt : α → α → Bool) (first last : α)
    (middle : List α)
    (chain : (first :: (middle ++ [last])).IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) :
    runsOpsBy lt (first :: (middle ++ [last])) =
      ([((buildAscending first middle).1 [last]).1],
        (buildAscending first middle).2 + ((buildAscending first middle).1 [last]).2 +
          2 * middle.length + 5)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.ascOpsBy_work_of_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascOpsBy_work_of_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (f : Builder α)
    (ys : List α) (k : Nat) (cost : AppCost f k)
    (chain : (a :: ys).IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) :
    (ascOpsBy lt a f ys).2 = k + 6 * ys.length + 3

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.descOpsBy_work_of_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem descOpsBy_work_of_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) (acc ys : List α)
    (chain : (a :: ys).IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = true)) :
    (descOpsBy lt a acc ys).2 = 3 * ys.length + 3

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_work_ascending_add_five
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_work_ascending_add_five (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ xs.length) (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) :
    (runsOpsBy lt xs).2 + 5 = 6 * xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_work_ascending
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_work_ascending (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ xs.length) (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) :
    (runsOpsBy lt xs).2 = 6 * xs.length - 5

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_of_ascending_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_of_ascending_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ xs.length) (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) :
    runsOpsBy lt xs = ([xs], 6 * xs.length - 5)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_work_descending
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_work_descending (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (hne : xs ≠ []) (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = true)) :
    (runsOpsBy lt xs).2 = 3 * xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_of_descending_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_of_descending_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (hne : xs ≠ []) (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = true)) :
    runsOpsBy lt xs = ([xs.reverse], 3 * xs.length)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_of_sorted
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_of_sorted [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (sorted : KeySorted key xs) (hlen : 2 ≤ xs.length) :
    runsOpsBy (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs = ([xs], 6 * xs.length - 5)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOpsBy_of_strictly_descending
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOpsBy_of_strictly_descending [LT κ] [DecidableLT κ]
    (key : α → κ) (xs : List α) (descending : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => key y < key x))
    (hne : xs ≠ []) :
    runsOpsBy (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs = ([xs.reverse], 3 * xs.length)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.baseMergeOps
declarations.source_header: def baseMergeOps : (xss : List (List α)) → xss.length ≤ 1 → Measured (List α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.baseMergeOps_nil
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem baseMergeOps_nil (h : ([] : List (List α)).length ≤ 1) :
    baseMergeOps [] h = ([], 1)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.baseMergeOps_singleton
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem baseMergeOps_singleton (xs : List α) (h : [xs].length ≤ 1) :
    baseMergeOps [xs] h = (xs, 1)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.baseMergeOps_spec
declarations.source_header:
theorem baseMergeOps_spec (cmp : α → α → Bool) (xss : List (List α))
    (h : xss.length ≤ 1) : baseMergeOps xss h = (mergeAllBy cmp xss, 1)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.baseMergeOps_eq_tick_allRun
declarations.source_header:
theorem baseMergeOps_eq_tick_allRun (cmp : α → α → Bool) (xss : List (List α))
    (h : xss.length ≤ 1) :
    baseMergeOps xss h = CallCount.tick (BottomUpSorting.allRun cmp xss)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy
declarations.source_header:
def singleRunOpsBy (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) : Measured (List α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_spec
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_spec (lt cmp : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) :
    singleRunOpsBy lt xs h = (sortNaturalBy lt cmp xs, (runsOpsBy lt xs).2 + 1)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_value (lt cmp : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) :
    (singleRunOpsBy lt xs h).1 = sortNaturalBy lt cmp xs

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_work
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_work (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) :
    (singleRunOpsBy lt xs h).2 = (runsOpsBy lt xs).2 + 1

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_work_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_work_le (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) :
    (singleRunOpsBy lt xs h).2 ≤ 6 * xs.length + 2

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_perm
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_perm (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) :
    (singleRunOpsBy lt xs h).1.Perm xs

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_correct
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_correct [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsOn key xs).length ≤ 1) :
    KeySorted key (singleRunOpsBy (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs h).1 ∧
      (singleRunOpsBy (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs h).1.Perm xs

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_nil
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem singleRunOpsBy_nil (lt : α → α → Bool)
    (h : (runsBy lt []).length ≤ 1) : singleRunOpsBy lt [] h = ([], 2)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_singleton
declarations.source_header:
@[simp] theorem singleRunOpsBy_singleton (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α)
    (h : (runsBy lt [a]).length ≤ 1) : singleRunOpsBy lt [a] h = ([a], 4)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsBy_length_le_one_of_ascending_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsBy_length_le_one_of_ascending_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsBy_length_le_one_of_descending_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsBy_length_le_one_of_descending_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = true)) : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_of_ascending_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_of_ascending_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) (hlen : 2 ≤ xs.length)
    (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = false)) :
    singleRunOpsBy lt xs h = (xs, 6 * xs.length - 4)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_of_descending_chain
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_of_descending_chain (lt : α → α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : (runsBy lt xs).length ≤ 1) (hne : xs ≠ [])
    (chain : xs.IsChain (fun x y => lt y x = true)) :
    singleRunOpsBy lt xs h = (xs.reverse, 3 * xs.length + 1)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOn_length_le_one_of_sorted
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOn_length_le_one_of_sorted [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (sorted : KeySorted key xs) : (runsOn key xs).length ≤ 1

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.runsOn_length_le_one_of_strictly_descending
declarations.source_header:
theorem runsOn_length_le_one_of_strictly_descending [LT κ] [DecidableLT κ]
    (key : α → κ) (xs : List α) (descending : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => key y < key x)) :
    (runsOn key xs).length ≤ 1

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_of_sorted
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_of_sorted [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (sorted : KeySorted key xs) (hlen : 2 ≤ xs.length) :
    singleRunOpsBy (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs
      (runsOn_length_le_one_of_sorted key xs sorted) = (xs, 6 * xs.length - 4)

declarations.name: Resources.NaturalRunOperations.singleRunOpsBy_of_strictly_descending
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleRunOpsBy_of_strictly_descending [LT κ] [DecidableLT κ]
    (key : α → κ) (xs : List α) (descending : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => key y < key x))
    (hne : xs ≠ []) :
    singleRunOpsBy (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs
      (runsOn_length_le_one_of_strictly_descending key xs descending) =
        (xs.reverse, 3 * xs.length + 1)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.empty_payload
declarations.source_header:
theorem empty_payload :
    runsOpsBy (fun a _ : Empty => nomatch a) [] = ([], 1)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.empty_payload_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem empty_payload_execution :
    singleRunOpsBy (fun a _ : Empty => nomatch a) [] (by simp) = ([], 2)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.singleton_payload
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleton_payload (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) :
    runsOpsBy lt [a] = ([[a]], 3)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.singleton_payload_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleton_payload_execution (lt : α → α → Bool) (a : α) :
    singleRunOpsBy lt [a] (by simp) = ([a], 4)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.ascending_two
declarations.source_header: theorem ascending_two : runsOpsBy natLT [1, 2] = ([[1, 2]], 7)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.ascending_three
declarations.source_header: theorem ascending_three : runsOpsBy natLT [1, 2, 3] = ([[1, 2, 3]], 13)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.ascending_two_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascending_two_execution :
    singleRunOpsBy natLT [1, 2]
      (runsOn_length_le_one_of_sorted id [1, 2] (by decide)) = ([1, 2], 8)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.ascending_three_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascending_three_execution :
    singleRunOpsBy natLT [1, 2, 3]
      (runsOn_length_le_one_of_sorted id [1, 2, 3] (by decide)) = ([1, 2, 3], 14)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.descending_two
declarations.source_header: theorem descending_two : runsOpsBy natLT [2, 1] = ([[1, 2]], 6)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.descending_three
declarations.source_header: theorem descending_three : runsOpsBy natLT [3, 2, 1] = ([[1, 2, 3]], 9)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.descending_two_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem descending_two_execution :
    singleRunOpsBy natLT [2, 1]
      (runsOn_length_le_one_of_strictly_descending id [2, 1] (by decide)) = ([1, 2], 7)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.descending_three_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem descending_three_execution :
    singleRunOpsBy natLT [3, 2, 1]
      (runsOn_length_le_one_of_strictly_descending id [3, 2, 1] (by decide)) =
        ([1, 2, 3], 10)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.ascending_ties
declarations.source_header: theorem ascending_ties : runsOpsBy natLT [1, 1, 2, 3] = ([[1, 1, 2, 3]], 19)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.ascending_ties_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem ascending_ties_execution :
    singleRunOpsBy natLT [1, 1, 2, 3]
      (runsOn_length_le_one_of_sorted id [1, 1, 2, 3] (by decide)) =
        ([1, 1, 2, 3], 20)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.three_boundary_worker
declarations.source_header: theorem three_boundary_worker : descOpsBy natLT 1 [3] [2] = ([[1, 3], [2]], 7)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.three_boundary
declarations.source_header: theorem three_boundary : runsOpsBy natLT [3, 1, 2] = ([[1, 3], [2]], 10)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.restart_worker
declarations.source_header:
theorem restart_worker :
    ascOpsBy natLT 3 (singleton 1) [2, 4] = ([[1, 3], [2, 4]], 12)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.restart_boundary
declarations.source_header: theorem restart_boundary : runsOpsBy natLT [1, 3, 2, 4] = ([[1, 3], [2, 4]], 15)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.odd_runs
declarations.source_header:
theorem odd_runs :
    runsOpsBy natLT [1, 3, 2, 4, 0] = ([[1, 3], [2, 4], [0]], 19)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.weak_descent_with_ties
declarations.source_header:
theorem weak_descent_with_ties :
    runsOpsBy (fun a b : Record => decide (a.1 < b.1))
      [(3, "A"), (3, "B"), (2, "C")] =
        ([[(3, "A"), (3, "B")], [(2, "C")]], 11)

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.multiple_runs_outside_dispatch
declarations.source_header:
theorem multiple_runs_outside_dispatch :
    ¬(runsBy natLT [3, 1, 2]).length ≤ 1 ∧
      ¬(runsBy natLT [1, 3, 2, 4]).length ≤ 1 ∧
      ¬(runsBy natLT [1, 3, 2, 4, 0]).length ≤ 1

declarations.name: Examples.NaturalRunOperations.weak_descent_outside_dispatch
declarations.source_header:
